about: Real screenshots of the tools in templates/studios.json, used only where the project's own terms clearly allow it. One record per tool id. 'small' and 'w' are the two widths made for the website (site/assets/toolbox); 'app' is the width the app's Workshop uses (app/ui/assets/studios); 'site': false means the tool is not on the website's toolbox page, so only the app file is made. scripts/dev/toolbox-shots.py makes the files from 'original'; scripts/dev/site-toolbox.js writes site/assets/toolbox/credits.json from this file. A tool with no record here keeps its drawn card (docs/SCREENSHOT-PERMISSIONS.md says why).
